name: HopeLend empty-market liquidity index inflation
summary: HopeLend, an Aave V3 fork, listed WBTC as collateral with an empty hEthWBTC market. The exploiter deposited a little WBTC, pumped the liquidity index with repeated flash loans whose premium accrues to the few suppliers, borrowed every other reserve against the inflated balance, and withdrew its WBTC through rayDiv rounding that burns fewer shares than owed.
notes: The exploit needed WBTC usable as collateral: configureReserves set its LTV, borrowing and flash loans two blocks after the empty hEthWBTC market was initialised, so that market-listing config is the latest reset. Later interest-rate strategy changes touched other reserves only.

HOPE and stHOPE are valued at what the attacker realised: it swapped the stHOPE to HOPE and sold all HOPE for USDT about a third below the DefiLlama price; the proceeds are split pro rata by HOPE amount.

The anchor was sent by a MEV bot that copied the exploiter's transaction and kept the take; it is unaffiliated with HopeLend, so it anchors the incident. No further successful exploit transaction followed.
